config_name: HyperX OMEN 16 Edition — AMD Ryzen 9 8940HX, RTX 5070 Laptop 8GB, 16GB DDR5, 512GB SSD, 16" WQXGA 165Hz

specs.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Laptop 8GB GDDR7 (Advanced Optimus, ~115W)
specs.keyboard_notes: Full-size with numpad, 4-zone RGB; HyperX co-branded edition

battery.notes: ~83Wh. 16-core 8940HX is the thirstiest CPU in the line; OMEN-line users report ~4h light use on HX chips.

price.notes: BBY sku 20132584, sale $1,999.99 (reg anchor $2,699.99) verified 2026-11-24. BBY customer pool 4.73/5, n=44 — best-rated OMEN 16 tier.

offers.name: HyperX OMEN 16 16" 165Hz Gaming Laptop - AMD Ryzen 9 8940HX - 16GB DDR5 RAM - 512GB SSD - GeForce RTX 5070

reviews.quote: The best budget gamer? Pros: clean, cohesive design; solid keyboard and touchpad; excellent CPU/GPU performance; cool surface temperatures even under load. Cons: fingerprint-prone surfaces; no USB 4, Thunderbolt, or SD reader; only Wi-Fi 6; subpar display with slow response times; ad-bloated control center; single-channel RAM; relatively small battery.

praises: Best-rated OMEN 16 at BBY (4.73/5, n=44): RTX 5070 + 16-core Ryzen 9 under $2,000 on sale is the value standout of the line
WQXGA 165Hz panel gets praise for smoothness and sharpness vs the FHD entry tier
16-core 8940HX handles multitasking/streaming alongside gaming without stutter (BBY theme)
HyperX Edition bundle and clean looks popular as a gift build (BBY reviewers)
Socketed RAM + M.2 keep it cheap to upgrade despite the small stock config
complaints: 512GB SSD fills after 2-3 AAA games — storage upgrade practically mandatory
Only 16GB RAM for a 16-core CPU; owners upgrade immediately
Battery ~3-4h: the 8940HX is the least efficient chip in the OMEN 16 range
Fans audibly ramp in Performance mode; plasma-cutting coil-whine reports in OMEN-line forums
$2,699.99 regular-price anchor is inflated — the real street price is the $1,999.99 sale

design_philosophy: A Best Buy co-branded edition of the mainstream OMEN 16 that stuffs a workstation-class 16-core Ryzen 9 and RTX 5070 into the value chassis at a sub-$2,000 sale price, trimming RAM and storage to protect the number. It embodies the OMEN 16 bet: GPU/CPU horsepower first, everything else upgradeable later.
rating_notes: Pro score attached from NBC OMEN 16 2025 review (83%, gap-fill 2026-11-24); WQXGA tiers may differ from the reviewed panel. Ratings inferred from OMEN Max 16 NBC anchor (SHARED-omen-max16.md) with mainstream-chassis deltas as in 160.json, then config deltas from SHARED-omen16.md: 5060→5070 gaming +1.5 (5.5→7.0); 8940HX vs 240H productivity +1.0 but thermals −1.0 (16c Zen4 heat) and battery −0.5; WQXGA panel screen_quality +1.0; 512GB/16GB keep productivity/ai_ml capped (no +0.5s). Strong BBY user pool (4.73/5, n=44) supports gaming/thermals not being scored below line average.
